ICD Code Web Scraper

Source: R/webscrape_icd.R
webscrape_icd.Rd

Function to web scrape ICD discharge diagnosis code sets from the CMS website. If pulling ICD-10 codes, by default the function will attempt to pull the diagnosis code update file for the current year. Users can specify earlier publication years from the last 6 years if needed. The ICD-9 option will only pull the most recent, final ICD-9 code set publication from 2014. This function will return an error message if the requested diagnosis code update file is not yet available or if the CMS website is unresponsive. The result is a tibble with 5 fields: version, code, description, published_year, and fy_update_year. Codes are standardized to upper case with punctuation and extra leading/tailing white space removed to enable successful joining.

Usage

webscrape_icd(icd_version = "ICD10", year = NULL, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

icd_version

A character value of either "ICD10" or "ICD9" to specify ICD version

year

A numeric integer indicating the publication year of desired ICD-10 code set. ICD-10 diagnosis code update files are published on October 1 of each year. Defaults to NULL to pull the most recent year's publication. An error will occur if this argument is used in combination with setting`icd_version` to "ICD9".

quiet

logical. If TRUE, suppress status messages (if any), and the progress bar.

Value

A tibble

References

  • CMS website for published ICD-10 diagnosis code update files

  • CMS website for published ICD-9 diagnosis code files

Examples


# Example 1
icd9_2014 <- webscrape_icd(icd_version = "ICD9")
head(icd9_2014)

# Example 2
icd10_2025 <- webscrape_icd(icd_version = "ICD10", year = 2025)
head(icd10_2025)

# Example 3
icd10_2026 <- webscrape_icd(icd_version = "ICD10", year = 2026)
head(icd10_2026)
